svg.title: JavCMS: 17 themes, one switch
svg.desc: An abstract video site recoloured with the real accent colour of each of the 17 JavCMS themes, with the theme folder name above it: javcms-modern, jav, jav-modern, ember, ember-modern, onyx, onyx-modern, velvet, velvet-modern, honey, honey-modern, neon, neon-modern, crimson, crimson-modern, topaz, topaz-modern.
